correctness.rationale: The reduction to H_K(y,z)=(z,K[g(y)-g(z)]^2) is exact for periodic points. Repeated triples solve K s(s-1)^2=1; distinct triples force elementary sums S=6/5,q=9/25 and cubic C_K(t)=(t-1/5)^2(t-4/5)+1/(3K). Vieta converse proves both cyclic orders, not just necessary conditions. Independently recomputed cubic discriminant 3(12K-125)/(125K^2) and verified residual equations for both orientations at K=11,12,100; threshold double root 0,3/5 is already the repeated branch. This establishes all real nonzero kappa and endpoints; numerical roots are corroboration only.
residual_risks: Bounded independent calculations cannot replace the analytic universal argument; see proof boundary.
